title: Preserve confirmed not-applied results when an Engram lock retry cannot be funded
outcome: Preserve confirmed not-applied results when an Engram lock retry cannot be funded
acceptance: A confirmed locked-store first attempt remains definitively not applied when its shared absolute window cannot admit the retry, without issuing another command.
Evaluation-submit and policy-write callers retain the safe retry classification in a scripted-clock behavioral test; unconfirmed outcomes remain unknown.
